title: LeeTKOB C++ analyzer result, version 1
description: Bounded JSON written by the native libclang analyzer and consumed by the Go checker. Go does not link libclang. status unsure means the analysis is unsupported; references must then be ignored and must not be turned into a violation. Locations are lines in the submitted source, never a system header.

reason.description: Short machine reason when status is unsure. Empty when status is ok.

name.description: Unqualified identifier as resolved, or the header spelling for an include.

qualifiedName.description: Resolved declaration name with inline standard-library namespaces removed, such as std::sort.

header.description: Header the declaration was reached through from the submitted file, such as algorithm. Empty for a user declaration.

userDeclared.description: True when the resolved declaration is written in the submitted file.

line.description: One-based line in the submitted source.
